summary: CIBC (Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce) filed a Form 6-K announcing its agreement to sell a 91.67% interest in CIBC Caribbean to The Bank of N.T. Butterfield Son for total consideration of approximately US$1.6 billion, comprising US$1 billion in cash and 52,100,024 Butterfield common shares valued at US$645 million (about 22% minority interest). The transaction is expected to close in H1 2027, subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals, and is projected to increase CIBC's CET1 ratio by 24 bps. Watch for Butterfield shareholder vote and regulatory timelines; risk-arb focuses on closing conditions and currency fluctuations.
